title: NAS message container
text: This information element is used to encapsulate the SMS messages transferred between the UE and the network. The NAS message container information element is coded as shown in figure 9.9.3.22.1 and table 9.9.3.22.1
The NAS message container is a type 4 information element with a minimum length of 4 octets and a maximum length of 253 octets

fields.description: NAS message container information element identifier

fields.name: Length of NAS message container contents
fields.description: Length of the NAS message container contents field

fields.name: NAS message container contents
fields.description: This IE can contain an SMS message (i.e. CP-DATA, CP-ACK or CP-ERROR) as defined in clause 7.2 in 3GPP TS 24.011 [13A]
